title: Warm lane claim yields untracked AppleDouble sidecars
wanted_capability: A freshly claimed pool lane should have a clean git worktree so branch diffs, verification, and closeout reflect only task-owned changes.
missing_primitive: Lane provisioning or NFS mount hygiene that suppresses or cleans macOS AppleDouble ._* metadata files before claim.
fallback_used: Ignore AppleDouble metadata repository-wide with `._*`, while still scoping every stage and commit operation to explicitly task-owned paths.
evidence: Fresh bpool1 claim at beta/blackbox-v2 reported dozens of untracked ._* files before any project edit.
Editing a lane-owned gap later created `.bbox/gaps/._gap-cd5edeee.json`, confirming that sidecars continue to appear during normal NFS-backed work, not only provisioning
notes: This creates immediate multi-tenant ownership ambiguity and can pollute clean-worktree checks or broad staging. The repo ignore removes git-status pollution, but lane provisioning should still suppress or clean the metadata so every project does not need its own workaround. Reproduce by claiming a warm pool lane from macOS and running git status --short.
